portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: The recovery cases your institution tracks: next dates, stage and adverse orders, as the courts last published them.
portfolio.readOnly: Only owners can create portfolios and import cases.

empty.title: No portfolio yet
empty.hint: Create a portfolio, then import a CSV of CNRs or case numbers to start tracking.

import.title: Import cases
import.hint: Upload a CSV with a CNR or Case Number column (up to 1,000 rows). Watches are created under your panel advocates; nothing is fetched at import.
import.done: {created, plural, one {# case imported} other {# cases imported}}
import.report: {created} imported, {duplicates} already tracked, {invalid} invalid. {watched} watched, {unwatched} without a watch.

alerts.title: Exception alerts
alerts.hint: Choose how you hear about a new adverse order or a missed next date on a portfolio case.
